say:2:1211205001:1.text: The village looks like it's been pillaged.
say:2:1211205001:1.source_cn: 这村子看起来……被入侵了。
say:2:1211205001:1.male: The village looks like it's been pillaged.
say:2:1211205001:1.female: The village looks like it's been pillaged.

say:3:1211205002:1.text: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.
say:3:1211205002:1.source_cn: 看房门，有人从门外暴力破门而入。目光所及，几乎都是这样。
say:3:1211205002:1.male: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.
say:3:1211205002:1.female: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.

say:4:1211205003:1.text: What happened here?! Were all the villagers captured by the Water Wights and the Dead Tide Fleet?
say:4:1211205003:1.source_cn: 这里发生了什么？！难道村民全都被水鬼帮或死潮舰队抓走了？

say:7:1211205004:1.text: But why would the Dead Tide Fleet take the villagers? They're already undead. Real people need to eat and sleep and can't work forever.
say:7:1211205004:1.source_cn: 但是死潮舰队抓村民有什么用呢？他们本身就是不知疲倦的亡灵……

say:8:1211205005:1.text: Well, there are never enough workers, and they also need more sea stingers. We always send their spies to work in Darkstone Cave.
say:8:1211205005:1.source_cn: 哼，劳力和薪柴永远不够用。我们也会打发水鬼帮的海蝎子去...

say:9:1211205006:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet has failed to capture Rustport so many times. Maybe they need more men, or they just want to vent their anger somehow.
say:9:1211205006:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队对锈锚港久攻不下，来捉人补充或是单纯泄愤都不奇怪。

say:10:1211205007:1.text: But it's a whole village! So many houses, so many people...
say:10:1211205007:1.source_cn: 但是，这里是一整座村子啊！那么多民居，那么多人——

say:11:1211205008:1.text: Our casualties have also been high.
say:11:1211205008:1.source_cn: 我们弟兄的死伤人数只多不少。

say:12:1211205009:1.text: Our brothers and sisters would be lucky if their bodies found their way to the shore and were buried properly.
say:12:1211205009:1.source_cn: 如果尸首能被海波送回岸边，能有一块可以安眠的土地，都算...

say:13:1211205010:1.text: Those who became fish food or ended up at the bottom of the sea are too numerous to count.
say:13:1211205010:1.source_cn: 葬身海底和鱼腹的，更不计其数。

choice_prompt:14:1211205010.text: Those who became fish food or ended up at the bottom of the sea are too numerous to count.
choice_prompt:14:1211205010.source_cn: 葬身海底和鱼腹的，更不计其数。

say:15:1211205011:1.text: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.
say:15:1211205011:1.source_cn: 如果是死潮干的，就不可能。
say:15:1211205011:1.male: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.
say:15:1211205011:1.female: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.

say:17:1211205013:1.text: Let's split up and search separately.
say:17:1211205013:1.male: Let's split up and search separately.
say:17:1211205013:1.female: Let's split up and search separately.

say:18:1211205014:1.text: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.
say:18:1211205014:1.source_cn: 我不想多浪费时间，但搞清楚这里到底发生过什么，对于我们...
say:18:1211205014:1.male: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.
say:18:1211205014:1.female: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.

say:19:1211205015:1.text: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!
say:19:1211205015:1.source_cn: 我的目标就是刺中霍德希金的心脏，撕裂他的灵魂，瞧瞧他的...
say:19:1211205015:1.male: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!
say:19:1211205015:1.female: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!

say:21:1211205016:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...
say:21:1211205016:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...
say:21:1211205016:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...

say:22:1211205017:1.text: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.
say:22:1211205017:1.source_cn: 如果能有生还者……不，哪怕能收敛找到的遗物，也可以慰藉...
say:22:1211205017:1.male: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.
say:22:1211205017:1.female: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.

say:23:1211205018:1.text: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
say:23:1211205018:1.source_cn: 那就是我们这些还活着的人的意义！
say:23:1211205018:1.male: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
say:23:1211205018:1.female: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.

choice_prompt:24:1211205018.text: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.source_cn: 那就是我们这些还活着的人的意义！
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.male: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.female: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.

say:25:1211205019:1.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.
say:25:1211205019:1.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.
say:25:1211205019:1.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我也对村里情况很在意

choice:14:0:1.text: Will there be any survivors here?
choice:14:0:1.male: Will there be any survivors here?
choice:14:0:1.female: Will there be any survivors here?

choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 我们再在村里调查看看吧

say:27:1211205012:1.text: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.
say:27:1211205012:1.source_cn: 同情和怜悯……会成为被敌人拿来威胁的武器。
say:27:1211205012:1.male: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.
say:27:1211205012:1.female: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.

choice:14:2:3.text: Then you should show more sympathy.
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: 那么，你该展示更多同情
choice:14:2:3.male: Then you should show more sympathy.
choice:14:2:3.female: Then you should show more sympathy.
